app.name: Dawri
home.title: Take your number from your phone
home.lead: Join the line from wherever you are; we alert you two turns before yours.
home.demo_staff_hint: Open a staff screen in another tab and try “Call next”:
home.owner_lead: Set up Dawri yourself in 10 minutes, free for 14 days.
locked.label: Locked
shop.dropoff_hint: Hand it to staff and scan the code on their screen
join.title: Take a number
join.party_hint: One ticket for the family; the wait counts everyone
join.refused: We can't give you a number right now
receipt.title: Track your order
receipt.lead: Type the order number printed on your receipt and we'll alert you when it's ready.
receipt.label: Order number
ticket.return_now: Head back now, two turns before you
push.title: Want an alert before your turn?
push.lead: Turn on alerts and we'll ring your phone two turns before yours, even with the page closed.
push.off: Alerts are off, keep an eye on the screen
push.ios_title: Two steps to turn on alerts
push.ios_step1: Tap the Share button in the browser bar
push.ios_step2: Choose “Add to Home Screen”, then open Dawri from the icon
late.title: Running late?
late.lead: We'll move your number back instead of losing it.
leave.title: Leave the line?
leave.lead: Your number will be dropped and the next person moves up.
redeem.title: Use: {title}
redeem.lead: Ask staff for the code on their screen and type it here.
feedback.title: How was the service?
feedback.why: What went wrong? Only the owner sees this
loyalty.title: Loyalty visits
loyalty.lead: Add your mobile to collect visits. Used for loyalty only; we never send messages.
loyalty.consent: I agree to save my number for the loyalty program, and the shop may contact me if I stop visiting
qa.title: Ask about the shop
qa.lead: Answers come only from this page's information.
claim.used: A pickup link works once. Ask staff to show the code again.
quest.phone_title: We count visits by your mobile
quest.phone_lead: Add your mobile once and every visit counts automatically when your turn is done. We never send messages.
quest.started: Challenge started! Today's visit counts when your turn is done
quest.shop_hint: Start a challenge from your ticket after you take a number
showcase.title: While you wait
showcase.sub: Your turn is in about {m} minutes, see what's here for you
showcase.wanted_note: Staff can see it and will have it ready with your turn
